title: For The People Resisting Destruction
paragraphs: “Naofumi, you should remember. When you went hunting in the sea with that orca woman, you mentioned that the experience gained was higher than on land.”
“Yeah. I remember wondering why… but no way…”
“That’s right. This thing can only extend its reach to the continent. It can’t reach the sea. That’s probably why the Spear Hero’s weapon was salvaged from the ocean.”

What!? Such a secret is being revealed here? Come to think of it, in the first world, Father was surprised Big Sister’s level was increasing faster. Even in this world, those who accompanied big sister seemed to level up faster.
“In other words, defeating that thing will not only reactivate the area but also increase the experience gained worldwide.”
“…I never imagined they would go to such lengths to ensure that people can’t resist the wave.”
“I don’t know who’s pulling the strings, but there’s no reason to let something like you, who produces demons and continues to interfere, live!”
“For the people of this world who are resisting destruction, we will defeat you!”
Why is Itsuki acting like he’s leading this? That’s Father’s job!
“I cannot fail in my mission for that person and fall before witnessing the end of the world. You’re just what I needed, heroes of the four cardinal weapons!”

Experience… what a nuisance. System Experience began emitting a red light, drawing multiple magic circles toward us… It seems to be chanting a spell. Moreover, the demons are gathering and rushing toward us.
“Perish here! I’ll show you the end of this world. Code: Balor, initiate!”

As soon as it finished speaking, a barrage of massive magic beams was unleashed simultaneously from the surrounding magic circles. At the same time, an unpleasant cracking sound echoed in my mind. Visually, the beams carried various attributes, and if we had tried to defend ourselves with attribute protection, we would have taken massive damage from an opposing attribute.
“Meteor Shield X!”
Father deployed the usual Meteor Shield. Thanks to that, none of us within the barrier took any damage. However… from the looks of it, that one spell alone had considerable firepower.
“Whoa! It’s so bright!”
We squinted and scanned the surroundings.
“Ugh… It’s not unbearable, but how long is this going to keep up?”
“I’ll use magic to improve visibility.”
Big sister gripped her staff and began chanting.
“All Draifa Dark Eyes.”

The excessively bright surroundings became somewhat easier to see. It’s like adjusting the brightness on a TV. Father continued to protect us from the attacks of System Experience, but… the barrage showed no signs of stopping. The beams kept coming, as if giving us no room to breathe.
“Continuous attacks, huh? This is annoying…”
“It’s not going to stop… Wait, didn’t we just hear the sound of a wave forming?”
“Yeah, no mistake. A wave has definitely appeared… The four cardinal heroes are the cornerstone of this world, right?”
“That’s right! If all four cardinal heroes are wiped out while the wave is happening, the world will end!”
So, this machine is trying to eliminate us. What an irritating… pest.
“In other words, by killing us here, it intends to bring about the end of the world.”
“Whether it’s the local energy field or the influence of System Experience, it’s trying to kill us to fulfill its purpose.”
“But what should we do? The enemy is constantly attacking us. It’s like they’re saying, ‘It’s my turn forever.’ Without Naofumi’s barrier, we’d be doomed.”
“In a normal game, there would be a gap where we could counterattack…”
“Thinking about it logically, if they could, they’d keep attacking endlessly…”
Father’s words made Ren and Itsuki groan in frustration.
“Counterattack timing? What are you talking about, Ren and Itsuki?”

They both looked at me in response. Filolial-sama’s eyes sparkled with excitement, delighted at the prospect of an opportunity to attack. Rival was glaring at System Experience, determined not to give up. Even big sister and the others were gathering their strength, refusing to be outdone. Yes… giving up here is not an option. The only path is forward.
“In times like these, there’s only one thing to do! Break through everything… and push even further ahead!”
From Father’s Shooting Star Shield, I extend the tip of my spear and unleash my skill with all my strength toward the system experience.
“Brionac X!!!”
A brilliant light shot out from my spear, pushing back the beams emitted by System Experience.

“So it comes down to this after all… I see. That earlier attack, Code: Balor, seems to have stirred up old grudges. Ren, you understand, right? That was the name of the enemy defeated by a god named Lugh.”
“Got it!”
Ren and Itsuki unleashed their skills alongside me.
“Fragarach X!”
“Tathlum X!”

Ren’s summoned sword pierced through the falling rain of light, slicing through the demons that had gathered and were supporting with magic. Itsuki’s skill merged with my Brionac, flying straight toward System Experience. Judging by the looks of it, we’re definitely dealing some damage. Let’s keep this momentum going!
“Futile. More importantly, look at this.”
Oh? Begging for mercy, are we? There’s no need for that—I’ll definitely kill you either way!
“That is…”
Father and the others stared at what System Experience was showing… It was an image, like a hologram. The map appeared to be captured from above.
…This terrain, I recognize it.
“Isn’t that our village?”
Ren’s words made Father and Itsuki nod. Indeed, it was Father’s village on display. But what about the village?
“By tracing the flow of experience, I have located areas where powerful entities converge. I have generated a wave there.”
“Wait a minute. Right now, only Keel and the others are in that village!”
“Yeah… We have to finish this thing off and get there immediately!”
What!?
This thing plans to destroy the village while we’re away?
…Filolial-sama and the others are there too.
I’m going to destroy this machine!
“Without the heroes, they are nothing more than rabble.”
On the map, red-black marks appeared around our village. Is that… a wave? Damn… we have to finish this thing off quickly!
“That’s not true.”
It was Father who spoke up.
“Everyone is there. In the nearby town, Melty-chan and Eclair-san are present. Even Melromarc Castle isn’t far.”

Now that he mentioned it, the villagers had received our help with leveling and even undergone limit breaking, so their combat abilities were quite high. Melty, Éclair, and the others were nearby, making this a formidable defensive lineup.
“During the first wave, we weren’t prepared, but now we have the Queen and even Trash.”
Hmm, if it’s those two, they would definitely take the necessary steps as soon as a wave appeared in their homeland. The more I hear, the more foolish System Experience seems.
“Everyone has been preparing for a day like this. They won’t go down so easily.”
“…That’s right. If you thought everything would go your way, you’re gravely mistaken!”
“Yes, at the very least, they should be able to hold out until we defeat the enemy and get there.”
“Honestly, they might even take down the wave without us.”
That possibility is quite high. After all, Filolial-sama and the others are there. Something as trivial as a wave should be easy for them to handle.
“That’s why it’s okay. I believe in everyone!”
“Keel-kun and the others are there, so they’ll be fine! Right, Raphtalia-chan?”
“Yes, this time… it won’t be like before.”
“Yeah, I think Keel-chan and the others can handle it now.”
“I’ve got the monsters I created as well. There’s no way they’ll lose.”
Big sister and the others were agreeing with Father’s words. That’s right. With this unbeatable lineup, there’s no way we can lose!
“Then, let’s continue! Here we gooooooo!”
In his humanoid form, Rival stood inside Father’s barrier, his body glowing as he summoned gleaming claws in both hands.
“These are the claws of the God Slayer, recorded in the memory of the first Dragon Emperor!”
The trajectory of those raised claws… it reminded me of the Zero Claws Filo-tan used to play around with. Could that technique actually work against this thing?
“We can’t afford to lose either!”
Yuki-chan and the other Filolial-samas began chanting in unison to provide support.
“Kou will do his best too! Rifana, Raphtalia, watch me!”
“I wanted to fight up close, but I’ll assist with magic instead!”
“To avoid the Catastrophe, the Dark Messiah’s Kuro and Ren will save the world!”
Each of the Filolial-samas added their own flair to the chant.
“Chorus Magic: Divine Bird!”
The chorus magic cast by the four Filolial-samas created a bird of fire, which merged with the skills unleashed by me and Itsuki, enhancing their power.
“We won’t lose either!”
“Yeah. Raphtalia-chan!”
“I’ll do my best. Let’s go together, Rifana-chan!”
“Haa… I’ll help too.”
Even the doctor joined in as big sister led the others in casting magic.
“Chorus Magic: Holy Seal!”
With a thud, some kind of seal appeared beneath our feet.
“What kind of effect does it have?”
“Not sure… but it feels like magic suited for this situation.”
The Brionac I was unleashing grew even stronger. Power was flowing from the seal beneath our feet, enhancing our skills. Is this some kind of skill amplification magic?
“Here I go! Uooooooohhhhhh, Filo-tannnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn—!”

I stepped forward with a heavy stomp and fired Brionac at full power. Waves of light erupted from the spear, piercing through System Experience. Yes… it’s the same power that blew away those reincarnators from the previous wave.
“Im… Impossible!? Code: Balor has been shattered!? The power of the dragon veins from all over the world has converged here! Do you think you Four Holy Heroes can oppose the entire world!?”
“The world? That’s Filo-tan, of course.”

Yes, the world is centered around Filo-tan. The world I protect is Filo-tan. The air and earth that exist around her are not the world to me. How should I put it… they’re just things that are nice to have.
“Motoyasu-kun, saying things like that just complicates matters.”
“The source of the world… in essence, the Four Holy Heroes. If anything, you’re the one defying the will of the world!”

At almost the same moment Rival spoke, my Brionac pierced through the magic circle created by System Experience. Even so, an incredibly strong barrier, as if determined to protect it, was still shielding System Experience. And beams of light were coming from other angles as well, making it impossible for us to leave Father’s barrier.
